optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Demand Forecasting Scientist, Retail Replenishment Service

professionalSummary.text: Developed and backtested demand forecast models for a retail replenishment service using 18 months of historical store sales data under a documented evaluation protocol, with model cards detailing limitations and feature dependencies.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and evaluated demand forecast models for the replenishment service in the offline experimentation environment, backtesting each candidate model over eighteen months of historical store sales extracts under the evaluation protocol agreed with the platform ML team. Wrote the model card and the evaluation report for each candidate model, listing the feature dependencies, the backtest results by store cluster and the known limitations of the offline sales extracts.

experienceHighlights.text: Handed over two accepted models to the platform ML team via model registry, with the team owning nightly order generation, release pipeline, and morning accuracy checks; candidate had no access to production run.
experienceHighlights.witness: Handed the two accepted candidate models to the platform ML team through the model registry; that team owned the nightly order run, the release pipeline and the morning accuracy checks, and I had no access to the run itself.

experienceHighlights.text: Specified feature pipeline changes needed by accepted models in feature request log and reviewed platform team's implementation against backtest assumptions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Specified the feature pipeline changes needed by the accepted models in the feature request log and reviewed the platform team's implementation against the backtest assumptions.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Backtest report for two accepted models with experiment run identifiers and model card for store-cluster model, documenting feature dependencies, backtest results by store cluster, and limitations of offline sales extracts.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the backtest report for the two accepted models with experiment run identifiers from the offline experimentation environment, and the model card for the store-cluster model. Recruiter screen: candidate said she 'deployed the forecasting models that drive the nightly orders' and that 'four hundred stores are running on my models'; asked who owned the nightly run, she said the platform ML team 'took it from there' after her registry hand-over.

skills.text: Model development, backtesting, model card documentation, feature pipeline specification, and model registry hand-over for retail replenishment forecasting.
skills.witness: Responsibilities covered offline model development, backtesting, model cards, feature specifications and registry hand-over for the replenishment forecasting programme over roughly two years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish offline model development, backtesting, model cards, and hand-over to platform team, but do not establish deployment into nightly production run, accuracy checks, or incident handling.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has not demonstrated deployment into nightly production run or handling of production incidents; requires human review to assess if hand-over process meets 'coordination' requirement.
